Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a â€œWHITEâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a â€œPINKâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the May 11, 2016 Regular Meeting, the May 18, 2016 Special Meeting, and May 18, 2016 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-06-08 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2016-06-08 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Contract Amendment for Dudek to Provide 5 Year Monitoring and Maintenance on the El Camino Real Channel Improvement Project (CD06D). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Hefner
City Council take the following actions: 1) Authorize the Public Works Director, to execute a contract amendment (Attachment 1), and any necessary extensions, with Dudek in the amount of $142,500 to perform post construction 5 year Habitat Maintenance and Biological Monitoring services for the El Camino Real Channel Improvement Project, for a total contract amount not to exceed $263,670; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2016-63 entitled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2015/16 Adopted Budget" (Attachment 2).
2016-06-08 Item 08C Dudek Contract Amendment Five Year Monitoring and Maintenance
8D.
Consideration of Resolution 2016-45 Approving the Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2016/17 Operating Budget and Resolution 2016-46 Approving the Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2016/17 Capital Budget. Contact Person: Management Analyst Wilson
It is recommended that Council take the following actions: 1) Adopt the Resolution No. 2016-45 Approving the Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2016/17 Operating Budget; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2016-46 Approving the Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2016/17 Capital Budget.
2016-06-08 Item 08D Encina Wastewater Authority FY 2016-17 Operating Budget and Resolution
8E.
Interim Landscape Maintenance Service Agreement. Acting Park Superintendent Stauffer
That the City Council Authorize the City Manager or Designee to Execute the Interim Landscape Maintenance Service Agreement.
2016-06-08 Item 08E Interim Landscape Maintenace Services Agreement
8F.
Contract for Dudek to Provide Design Services on the 2016-2017 Citywide Sewer Rehabilitation Project (CE04H and CC04E). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Hefner
Authorize the Public Works Director to execute a contract, any necessary amendments, and time extensions with Dudek in the amount of $217,761 plus 15% contingencies to design the 2016-2017 Citywide Sewer Rehabilitation Project, for a total contract amount not to exceed $250,426.
2016-06-08 Item 08F Award Design Contract Citywide Sewer Rehab Project
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the FY 2016/17 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
Council take the following actions: 1) Conduct a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the FY 2016/17 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District Annual Engineer's Report; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2016-60, Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Renewing the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District (Zones A, B, C, D, E, F, G & H), Confirming the FY 2016/17 Engineer's Report and ordering the transmission of charges to the County Auditor for collection ( Attachment 1).
2016-06-08 Item 10A Public Hearing Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District
10B.
Quarterly Progress Report of the City of Encinitas Work Program for Fiscal Years 2015-2016 and 2016-2017. Contact Person: Gina Zenns
Staff recommends that City Council take the following actions: 1) Receive the Quarterly Progress Report of the City of Encinitas Work Program for Fiscal Years 2015-2016 and 2016-2017; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2016-58, a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas in Support of the City's Participation in the Institute for Local Government's Beacon Award: Local Leadership toward Solving Climate Change.
2016-06-08 Item 10B Work Program Quarterly Progress Report
10C.
Introduction of City Manager's Proposed Fiscal Year 2016/17 Operating and Capital Budgets. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
Staff recommends that City Council take the following actions: 1) Review proposed FY 2016/17 operating and capital budgets; and 2) Receive public input; and 3) Provide direction to staff regarding City Council requested revisions to the proposed FY 2016/17, if desired.
2016-06-08 Item 10C Proposed FY2016-17 Operating and Capital Budgets
10D.
Fiscal Year 2015/16 Third Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
Staff recommends that City Council take the following actions: 1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2015/16 Third Quarter Budget Status report; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2016-61 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2015/16 Budget" (Attachment 1).
2016-06-08 Item 10D FY 2015-16 Third Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments
10E.
North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project (CS04D) Design Contract Amendments with Michael Baker International and MW Peltz & Associates. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Kellar
The City Council take the following actions: 1) Authorize the Director of Public Works to amend the contract with Michael Baker International as necessary to complete 100% civil engineering plans for three parking areas along the east side of N. Coast Highway 101 in an amount not to exceed $42,550, including contingencies; 2) Authorize the Director of Public Works to amend the contract with MW Peltz and Associates as necessary to complete 100% landscape and irrigation plans for three parking areas along the east side of N. Coast Highway 101 in an amount not to exceed $23,000, including contingencies; 3) Authorize the Director of Public Works to refine the proposed project phasing for the N. Coast Highway 101 Streetscape project; 4) Authorize the Director of Public Works to prepare and submit grant applications to obtain outside funding for construction of the N. Coast Highway 101 Streetscape project, as opportunities arise; and 5) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2016-50 entitled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget."
2016-06-08 Item 10E North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project
10F.
Proposal for Public Art at the Marine Safety Center. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
That the City Council: 1) Consider the recommendations for public art at the Marine Safety Center; and 2) Consider allocating City funds for Project 1, ($60,000).
2016-06-08 Item 10F Public Art Recommendations

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JUNE 15, 2016
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
